description: Manage Meltwater saved searches and tags; search mentions; inspect exports, account metadata and usage; watch searches and tags.

meltwater_new_mention_trigger.description: Runs for newly observed mentions published in the last 24 hours for the chosen saved search. Existing results form the first baseline. Narrow the saved search if more than 1,000 mentions match the window; a truncated window never advances the saved position.

parameters.description: Choose the id to watch.
parameters.name: id

meltwater_new_search_trigger.description: New search. Checks complete pages at your workspace polling interval; existing records form the first baseline.

meltwater_new_tag_trigger.description: New tag. Checks complete pages at your workspace polling interval; existing records form the first baseline.

meltwater_updated_search_trigger.description: Updated search. Checks complete pages at your workspace polling interval; existing records form the first baseline.
